title: Code-implementation benchmark wrapper output (BENCH_OUTPUT_FILE)
description: One document per competitor run. Every wrapper writes exactly this shape so a later aggregation step can merge results without vendor-specific parsing. null means 'unknown', never 'zero'.

schema_version.description: Schema revision; bump when a field changes meaning.

competitor.description: Competitor name, e.g. autonomous-engine or claude-cli.

task_id.description: BENCH_TASK_ID as exported by the runner.

outcome.description: passed_agent = the agent reports success and produced a checkout (hidden tests decide the real pass); failed = agent/product failure; blocked = the product escalated to a human instead of finishing; timeout = BENCH_TIME_LIMIT_S exceeded.

elapsed_s.description: Wall-clock seconds from wrapper start to result write.

head_sha.description: Commit checked out in BENCH_REPO when the wrapper returned; null when no commit was produced.

model_calls.description: Number of model invocations; null when unknown.

tokens_in.description: Prompt tokens processed (including cache reads/writes where the vendor reports them); null when unknown.

cost_usd.description: Billed cost in USD as reported by the vendor; null when unknown.

versions.description: Free-form provenance: CLI/build versions, model ids, wrapper version.

raw_ref.description: Absolute path to the raw wrapper log for this run (outside BENCH_REPO).

details.description: Free-form, competitor-specific diagnostics (state history, reasons, raw file paths).
